scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @animatch/api" "npm run dev -w @animatch/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @animatch/engine && npm run build -w @animatch/api && npm run build -w @animatch/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/engine/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
